question: Should the repository adopt this shared priority-budget policy for durable cluster intake, including its schema migration, as part of the five-layer reliability stack?
rationale: The patch defines a durable scheduling and upgrade contract rather than a narrow isolated bug fix; the intended balance between repair-intake latency and ordinary state-write fairness requires maintainer ownership of the operational policy.

options.title: Approve with stack-level proof
options.body: Review this layer with its dependent PRs and require an upgrade-plus-contention demonstration before landing the stack in order.

options.title: Keep ordinary FIFO scheduling
options.body: Reject the priority policy and retain the existing writer ordering if bounded intake latency is not worth the added durable scheduling contract.

recommendation.title: Approve with stack-level proof
recommendation.body: Review this layer with its dependent PRs and require an upgrade-plus-contention demonstration before landing the stack in order.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the connected five-layer design and can explain the intended priority budget, migration behavior, and dependency order.
